full_text_zh:
[P1] 给孩子的山海经神话绘本
羲和浴日
孟倩 编 〔越〕范广福 绘
南京开放大学出版社出版
厦门童趣（北京）文化传播有限公司出品

[P2] 给孩子的山海经神话绘本
羲和浴日
孟惜 编 [越]范广福 绘
国家开放大学出版社出版
中开童联(北京)文化传播有限公司出品
北京

[P3] 上古的时候，在遥远的东南海之外，
有一个叫羲和的国家。
羲和国里住着一位叫羲和的女子，
是天神帝俊的妻子。他们生下了十个太阳，
于是人们称羲和为太阳女神。

[P4] 羲和跟她的十个太阳儿子住在甘渊。甘渊也叫汤谷，那儿的水十分甘美。
每天晚上，羲和都会在汤谷里给儿子们洗澡，把一个个太阳洗得干净明亮。
汤谷有一棵扶桑树，是一棵千丈高的桑树，从它的根部生出两株繁茂的枝干，互相扶持，所以有了这个名字。
每次洗完澡，小太阳们都会舒舒服服地睡一觉。其中九个睡在扶桑树下，还有一个睡在树上。

[P5] 第二天，羲和会送睡在树上的太阳去照耀人间，一天后再换另一个太阳去……
就这样，十个太阳儿子轮流值班。
所以，虽然有十个太阳，但人们看到的却只有一个。

[P6] 每天，当天边还闪烁着点点星光时，值班的太阳就在羲和的陪伴下，在东边的汤谷等着神鸟三足乌驾着太阳神车来接。

[P7] 然后他们开始自东向西行进。从起点汤谷，升到扶桑树梢，再到曲阿站，最后到终点站禺谷。一天的路程总共有十五站。一路上太阳把光和热洒向大地，让人间万物得以生长。

[P8] 太阳神车到第十三站悲泉就停下了。剩下的两站，需要太阳自己走完。
可妈妈羲和不放心，她总是坐在车上，目送心爱的儿子走向下一站，
直到最后几缕阳光洒在终点站禺谷的树梢上。
8/17

[P9] 夜晚来临，太阳便不再发出光和热了，那时他会走回到悲泉，和妈妈羲和一起坐上太阳神车；伴着清凉的夜风，穿过满天繁星和云层，回到东方的汤谷。

[P10] 十个太阳儿子，天天由羲和护送，按照
严格规定的路线和程序，轮流去普照大地。
世间的人们日出而作，日落而息，生活
得幸福满足。

[P11] 这样，过了很久很久，直到有一天
十兄弟间别扭了……那天，羲和因为出
远门，没有亲自护送最小的儿子去值班。
九个太阳哥哥趁机欺负弟弟，他们一起
坐上了太阳神车，打闹成一团，一起把
光和热洒向人间大地……

[P12] 太阳们的调皮任性可让人间遭了殃。
庄稼、树木和花草被太阳炙烤，几乎成了灰烬。溪水断流了，湖水干涸了，连大江大海里的水都要被烤干了。很多动物和人都热死了……

[P13] 儿子们无视规则闯下大祸的行为让帝俊非常生气，他赐给神射手羿红色的弓和白色的箭，让他射下作乱的儿子以示惩罚。羿背着弓箭奔跑在炎热的大地上，翻过一座座高山，最后来到东海边。他搭上箭，拉开弓，朝着十个太阳射过去……

[P14] “嗖嗖嗖”，天上的太阳一个接一个地落下。
最终，羿留下了最小的太阳，而射落的九
个太阳再也没有资格乘坐太阳神车去值班了。

[P15] 从此，太阳每天从东方的汤谷升起，
在西方禺谷落下，规律运行……
人间大地又恢复了生机和活力。
full_text_en:
[P1] Mythological Picture Book from the Classic Shan Hai Jing for Children
Xihe Bathing the Sun
Compiled by Meng Qian, Illustrated by [Vietnam] Fan Guangfu
Published by Nanjing Open University Press
Produced by Xiamen Tongqu (Beijing) Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.

[P2] Mythological Picture Book from the Classic Shan Hai Jing for Children
Xihe Bathing the Sun
Compiled by Meng Xi, Illustrated by [Vietnam] Fan Guangfu
Published by Open University Press
Produced by Zhongkai Tonglian (Beijing) Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.
Beijing

[P3] In ancient times, beyond the distant southeastern sea,
there was a country called Xihe.
In the country of Xihe lived a woman named Xihe,
who was the wife of the heavenly deity Di Jun. They gave birth to ten suns,
and thus people called Xihe the Sun Goddess.

[P4] Xihe and her ten sun sons lived in Gan Yuan. Gan Yuan is also called Tang Gu, where the water is very sweet.
Every evening, Xihe would bathe her sons in Tang Gu, washing each sun clean and bright.
In Tang Gu there is a Fusang tree, a thousand-zhang tall mulberry tree, whose roots sprout two lush branches that support each other, hence its name.
After each bath, the little suns would sleep comfortably. Nine of them slept under the Fusang tree, and one slept on the tree.

[P5] The next day, Xihe would send the sun sleeping in the tree to shine upon the world, and then switch to another sun the following day...
In this way, the ten sun sons took turns on duty.
Therefore, although there were ten suns, people could only see one.

[P6] Every day, when the sky still sparkles with starlight, the on-duty sun, accompanied by Xihe, waits in the eastern Tanggu for the divine bird, the three-legged crow, to arrive in the solar chariot to pick them up.

[P7] Then they begin to travel from east to west. Starting from Tanggu, ascending to the top of the Fusang tree, then to Qu'a Station, and finally to the endpoint, Yugǔ. The journey of one day has fifteen stops. Along the way, the sun showers light and heat upon the earth, allowing all living things to grow.

[P8] The sun chariot stops at the thirteenth station, Beiquan. The remaining two stations must be walked by the sun alone.
But Mom Xihe is not at ease. She always sits in the chariot, watching her beloved son walk to the next station,
until the last few rays of sunlight fall on the treetops at the final station, Yugǔ.
8/17

[P9] When night falls, the sun no longer emits light or heat. Then, he walks back to Beiquan, and together with his mother Xihe, boards the solar chariot; accompanied by the cool night breeze, they pass through the sky full of stars and clouds, returning to the eastern Tanggu.

[P10] The ten sun sons, escorted daily by Xihe, follow
strictly defined routes and procedures, taking turns to illuminate the earth.
The people of the world rise with the sun and rest at sunset, living
happily and contentedly.

[P11] This way, after a long, long time, one day
the ten brothers had a disagreement... That day, Xihe was away on a trip and couldn't personally escort her youngest son to his shift.
The nine older sun brothers took the chance to bully their younger brother. Together, they climbed into the Sun Chariot, made a ruckus, and together poured light and heat upon the human world...

[P12] The suns' mischievous and任性 behavior brought disaster to the world.
Crops, trees, and flowers were scorched by the sun, almost turned to ashes. Streams dried up, lakes became barren, even the waters of great rivers and oceans were about to be baked dry. Many animals and people died of heat...

[P13] The sons' reckless actions, which caused great trouble, made Di Jun very angry. He gave the divine archer Yi a red bow and white arrows, ordering him to shoot down the rebellious sons as punishment. Yi ran across the scorching earth, crossing mountain after mountain, until he finally reached the eastern sea. He nocked an arrow, drew his bow, and aimed at the ten suns...

[P14] "Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh", the suns in the sky fell one after another.
In the end, Yi left the smallest sun, and the nine shot-down suns no longer had the qualification to ride the solar chariot for their shifts.

[P15] From then on, the sun rises every day from the Eastern Tanggu and sets in the Western Yugǔ, running in a regular cycle...
The world and the earth regained their vitality and energy.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《羲和浴日》的封面，画面中羲和怀抱三个孩子，周围环绕着太阳图案，背景是星空，展现了神话故事的温馨场景。
[P2] 本页为绘本《羲和浴日》的封面，展示了羲和怀抱太阳与孩童的插画，上方为书名、作者及出版社信息。
[P3] 本页介绍了上古时期东南海外的羲和国，讲述了羲和作为天神帝俊的妻子，生下十个太阳，因而被称为太阳女神的传说背景。
[P4] 本页描述了羲和在甘渊（汤谷）为十个太阳儿子洗澡的场景，并介绍了扶桑树的传说，以及小太阳们洗完澡后睡觉的安排。
[P5] 本页描绘了羲和乘坐由三足乌牵引的车，送一个太阳儿子去照耀人间的场景，并解释了十个太阳轮流值班，因此人们每天只看到一个太阳的传说。
[P6] 本页描绘了羲和陪伴值班的太阳在汤谷等待三足乌驾着太阳神车前来接应的场景，展现了太阳每日轮值的准备过程。
[P7] 本页描绘了太阳从汤谷出发，自东向西行进的路线图，途经扶桑树梢、曲阿站，最终抵达禺谷，共十五站，沿途为大地带来光和热，滋养万物。
[P8] 本页描绘了太阳神车在第十三站悲泉停下，羲和坐在车上目送儿子独自走完最后两站，直至阳光洒在终点站禺谷的树梢上，展现了母子间的深情与太阳每日旅程的结束。
[P9] 本页描绘了太阳在完成一天的旅程后，与母亲羲和一同乘坐太阳神车，穿越星空返回东方汤谷的场景，展现了母子间的温情与日落归家的宁静。
[P10] 本页描绘了羲和护送十个太阳儿子轮流照耀大地的和谐景象，人们日出而作、日落而息，生活幸福满足。
[P11] 本页描绘了十个太阳兄弟因母亲羲和外出未能护送最小的弟弟值班，导致九个哥哥趁机欺负弟弟，十兄弟一同乘坐太阳神车，打闹着将光和热洒向人间的场景。
[P12] 本页描绘了十个太阳同时出现导致大地干涸、万物枯萎的灾难景象，文字说明了庄稼、树木、水源枯竭，动植物和人类遭受酷热之苦。
[P13] 本页描绘了帝俊因十个太阳作乱而赐予羿弓箭，羿背负弓箭奔行于大地，最终抵达东海边，准备射下十个太阳的场景。
[P14] 羿射下九个太阳，只留下最小的一个，其余太阳被剥夺了乘坐太阳神车值班的资格。
[P15] 本页描绘了太阳每日从东方汤谷升起、在西方禺谷落下的规律运行景象，大地恢复生机，万物复苏。
[P16] 本页画面描绘了羲和与最小的太阳儿子乘坐太阳神车，在星空背景下穿越夜空，返回东方汤谷的场景，展现了母子归家的温馨与宁静。
